composition.serve_who: This sheet serves the vessel's primary steering system, detailing the structural general arrangement of the mechanical linkage, twin rudders, manual wheel steering sheaves, and the autopilot ram. The title 'Steering System GA' and the visual representation of bearings, tie rods, and redundant steering paths confirm it is the definitive structural reference for the mechanical steering installation.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The drawing acts as the primary GA for the mechanical steering linkages, showing how the helm wheels connect to the rudders.

functions.label: Mechanical Steering Linkage
functions.what_it_does: Connects the manual steering wheels to the rudder tiller arms via Vectran lines, sheaves, and tie rods, providing fully redundant mechanical control.
functions.dry_data: 3 independent systems (2 wheels + pilot); single rod failure leaves one rudder active; single wheel failure leaves second wheel in control of both rudders; part numbers capture at inspection.
functions.sheet_region: Plan View, Safety Notes, Parts Table, Detail A

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The drawing extensively details the structural positioning, toe-in geometry, and bearing arrangements for the dual rudders.

functions.label: Directional Control Surface
functions.what_it_does: Provides hydrodynamic directional control for the vessel, installed as a port and starboard mirrored pair with tunable toe-in geometry to generate the Ackermann effect.
functions.dry_data: Stbd mirrors port; 1.8° toe-in at neutral position with 2044mm rod links; Ackermann effect dynamically tunable ±365mm from CL.
functions.sheet_region: Perspective View, Section B-B, Section C-C, System Notes

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The drawing illustrates the installation of the autopilot ram and its direct structural connection to the steering system.

functions.label: Automated Steering Actuation
functions.what_it_does: Acts as a third independent steering source, driving the steering linkage automatically and remaining fully operational even if both manual wheels fail.
functions.dry_data: 500mm stroke Marsili ram; support is bolted through Bulkhead L with bond tapping plates on FWD face.
functions.sheet_region: Plan View, Autopilot Ram Support detail text, Parts Table

facts: Partitions LM1 and LM2 frame and integrate the lower bearing structure.
Bulkhead L (BHD L) provides structural mounting and bolting points for the autopilot ram support.
Tri-beam 11 is penetrated to accommodate the clearance required for pilot rod movement.
